reason: A DSH plugin for monitoring task-related events and presenting them through OS notifications, sounds, toasts, and an in-app notification panel with read and cleanup controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 监听审批、回复等待和任务完成等事件，并通过系统通知、提示音及应用内铃铛面板提醒用户。
summaries.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness task events and alerts users through OS notifications, chimes, toasts, and an in-app bell panel.

capabilities: listens for task, approval, reply, subagent, workflow, and background-job events
queues and retrieves notification records through host-side endpoints
displays in-app notifications, toasts, and a notification panel
requests browser notification permission and sends OS notifications
plays synthesized notification sounds using Web Audio
provides acknowledge, clear, purge, resend, and diagnostic controls
